title: God Is Love
story:
A young boy was walking home from school when he noticed an elderly man struggling to carry several heavy bags.

The boy stopped and offered to help.

He carried some of the bags and walked with the man until they reached his home.

The man thanked him and said, "That was very kind of you."

The boy smiled and replied, "My mother always tells me that when we can help someone, we should."

The boy had learned that love is more than something we say. Love is something we choose to show through our actions.

The Bible tells us that God is love.

God does not simply show love from time to time. Love is part of who He is.

His love is seen in the way He cares for us, forgives us, guides us, and gives us hope.

Most importantly, God's love was demonstrated through Jesus Christ, who gave Himself for us.

When we understand God's love, we do not need to live constantly trying to prove that we are worthy of being loved.

We can rest in the assurance that God already knows us completely and still loves us.

This love also changes the way we treat others.

If God's love lives in our hearts, it should become visible through patience, kindness, forgiveness, compassion, and generosity.

There may be people who are difficult to love, but God's love can help us respond differently.

We do not love others because they are always easy to love. We love because God first loved us.

Today, take time to remember how deeply God loves you.

Thank Him for His faithful love and ask Him to help you reflect that love to someone else.

When fear, rejection, or loneliness tries to convince you that you are alone, remember this truth: God is love, and His love is with you.
life_lesson: God's love is not temporary or dependent on circumstances. When you remain in His love, you can live with confidence and allow His love to flow through you to others.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me with a perfect and faithful love.

Help me understand more deeply that Your love does not depend on my success, failures, or circumstances.

When I feel rejected, lonely, or unworthy, remind me that You know me completely and still love me.

Help me remain in Your love and allow it to shape my thoughts, words, and actions.

Teach me to love others with patience, kindness, forgiveness, and compassion.

When someone is difficult to love, give me the grace to respond with the love You have shown me.

Help me not only speak about love but demonstrate it through the way I treat people.

Thank You for showing Your greatest love through Jesus Christ.

May Your love remove fear from my heart and fill me with peace, confidence, and hope.

Let my life become a reflection of Your love wherever I go.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you truly believe that God loves you even when you feel unworthy or have failed?

How is God's love changing the way you treat the people around you?

Who is one person you can show God's love to through your words or actions today?
verse: God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
